'''Kiam Lopiang''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] who lived at the time of the formation of the [[White Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kiam Lopiang}}

==History==
She is the only woman not named as being part of the group that met in {{Ab|47}} to discuss the building of a new city to become the centre for all Aes Sedai.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower}}

In {{Ab|98}} Kiam was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to [[Elisane Tishar]], the first [[Amyrlin Seat]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower}}  This is strong evidence that she and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven [[Ajah]] sisterhoods that would come to define [[Aes Sedai]] power and influence. She would have been an Ajah Head. Note that the [[Hall of the Tower]] did not yet exist, but would become established by {{Ab|202}}.
